blocks.text: SUBIC BAY FREEPORT, Zambales — A shipment of 150 pregnant dairy cattle imported from Australia by the National Dairy Authority (NDA) has arrived in Subic. This cargo is part of the government’s efforts to boost the country’s dairy cattle population and increase local milk production. In a statement on Friday, October 23, the NDA said the cattle arrived on Wednesday after being transported from the Port of Cagayan de Oro to Subic. The animals will be brought to the NDA’s General Tinio Stock Farm in Nueva Ecija, where they will undergo quarantine before being distributed to qualified dairy farmers in Northern […]...
